===·import·===
Usage:·provenance·import·[OPTIONS]·--input·<INPUT>

Options:
······--quiet············Drop·the·advisory·notes·commands·print·alongside·their·output,·such·as·the·warning·that·this·repository·has·no·shaping·skills·installed

······--format·<FORMAT>··[possible·values:·json]
······--input·<INPUT>····The·scope·export·file·to·import:·the·JSON·document·that·export·writes.
······--dry-run··········Run·each·check·of·the·import·and·write·nothing.
··-h,·--help·············Print·help
===·graph-reference-issue·===

Usage:·provenance·graph-reference·issue·[OPTIONS]

··········Drop·the·advisory·notes·commands·print·alongside·their·output,·such·as·the·warning·that·this·repository·has·no·shaping·skills·installed

··········[default:·.]
······--scope·<SCOPE>
··········[default:·default]
······--commit·<COMMIT>
··········Git·revision·to·pin.·When·omitted,·clean·relevant·state·at·HEAD·is·required
